name: Guitarricadelafuente
bio: Álvaro Lafuente Calvo (born 27 August 1997), known artistically and professionally as Guitarricadelafuente, is a Spanish singer, songwriter, guitarist and actor. In 2019, he gained recognition for his music after collaborating with Operación Triunfo contestant Natalia Lacunza on her debut single, "Nana Triste", which reached number four on the Spanish singles chart. Lafuente made his acting debut in 2026, starring in the Cannes Film Festival-winning film La bola negra, directed by Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi.

credits.title: LA BOLA NEGRA
credits.overview: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

credits.title: Bitter Christmas
credits.overview: During a long December holiday weekend, a woman, whose mother has recently died, throws herself into work as a form of escape. Her relentless pace is interrupted when a panic attack forces her to take a break.

credits.title: La Joia: Bad Gyal
credits.overview: Following how La Joia, Bad Gyal's first album, was made, a path full of lights and shadows in which a diamond in the rough ends up becoming a real jewel.

credits.title: Raphael, de tanta gente
credits.overview: Raphael performs some of his greatest hits and songs from his newest album alongside artists such as Pablo López, Nathy Peluso, Mónica Naranjo, Ricardo Montaner, Guitarricadelafuente, Fredi Leis, Israel Fernández, and Ana Mena.
